title: AI cost
description: What the AI chats cost, per chat and per question, with AWS prices.

options.content:
### What the AI chats cost
Every chat pays for its share of GPU memory all the time, plus the CPU and memory it uses. A question costs the seconds it keeps the model busy. **Questions + idle = total** for every chat. Prices are AWS on-demand list prices for the GPU node (g4dn.2xlarge, us-west-2), split into GPU, CPU and memory. Numbers follow the time range at the top right.

panels.title: How the cost is worked out

options.content:
- **Chat total** = GPU memory kept for it x GPU price x time, plus CPU and memory it really used.
- **Question** = its share of GPU x the seconds it kept the model busy (answer, title, follow-ups, reading documents), plus CPU and memory in those seconds.
- **Idle** = total minus questions: what the chat cost while nobody used it.
- GPU seconds are measured per call. CPU and memory per question are estimated from 15 second samples.
- The first question after a chat starts also pays for loading the model, so it costs more.
- Platform cost (HKS master, disks) is shared and not charged to chats.
